highest_priority_permission_question: Will SCDNR authorize release and commercial-directory reuse of a current saltwater charter-vessel list limited to vessel name, passenger class, and landing, or do section 30-2-50 and the identity rule in section 50-5-380 bar that use? No public roster, field dictionary, bulk file, or commercial-reuse grant was found.
